Mara (docs): Quick heads-up — I put together a tiny nslookup/dig snippet for the onprem minimal install guide to help customers verify egress/DNS to private endpoints. Posting the PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 :sparkles:
Ian (eng-infra): Nice. Can you show both UDP TCP and an explicit resolver example? Some installs route to a local resolver on 10.0.0.2 so that bites folks.
Mara (docs): Yep — I added examples. Current snippet (copied from PR):
```
# verify DNS resolves internal API via local resolver
nslookup api.internal.redwood.example 10.0.0.2
# fallback using dig over TCP
dig +tcp +short api.internal.redwood.example @10.0.0.2
# quick check for outbound reachability to public resolver
nslookup google.com 8.8.8.8
```
Sanjay (platform): Add a note about firewalls blocking outbound TCP/53 on some hardened networks — we saw that with a telco customer. Maybe recommend curl to the control-plane FQDN on port 443 as a secondary check.
Mara (docs): Good call. I appended a one-liner example: `curl -I https://control.redwood.example/health` and a short paragraph about port policies.
Lina (devex): I ran the doc-lint locally. Two tiny items: anchor link to the install checklist is broken and we should standardize the resolver IP placeholder (use <resolver-ip> instead of examples). Also request to keep snippet as copy-paste friendly (no comments inside fenced block).
Mara (docs): Will update — will change to `<resolver-ip>` and move inline comments below the block.
Ian (eng-infra): Also call out IPv6 caveat: on Windows the default `nslookup` ignores `/etc/hosts` equivalents in some setups. Suggest adding `ping -6` or `Get-DnsClientServerAddress` snippet for Windows.
Mara (docs): Added a short Windows note and example: `Get-DnsClientServerAddress -InterfaceAlias "Ethernet"` — kept this in the prose not the code block.
Sanjay (platform): One more: can we include expected failure troubleshooting for common error messages (e.g., "server can't find" vs timeout)? That reduces tickets.
Mara (docs): Good idea. I added two short bullet lines under the snippet with quick remediation steps.
deploy-bot: deploy check passed for docs site staging (build 2026-03-22-2100) :white_check_mark:
Lina (devex): I can review the PR after you make the placeholder and anchor fixes. @Ian if you want to sanity-check the Windows bit too.
Mara (docs): Thanks all — I'll push the updates in the next 30m and mark the PR ready for review. :thumbsup:
Ian (eng-infra): Thanks, this will shave a lot of onboarding time for sealed-site installs.
Mara (docs): Filed follow-up issue for adding a tiny e2e smoke test to the installer repo that runs the `curl` healthcheck — https://github.com/redwood-inference/installer/issues/456
Sanjay (platform): Perfect, leaving a short comment on the PR about the firewall troubleshooting checklist. :eyes:
Mara (docs): Done. Closing thread once PR is merged.
